description: Stop hook fired in a synthetic git repo with 6 commits + 11 modified files. Should score ≥12 in process-session-memory.py and emit a session-summary memory of the form 'Claude session in <project>. on branch <branch>. - Made N commits...' — the exact anti-pattern CLAUDE.md forbids and the 2026-04-28 audit flagged.
adversarial_twist: high — this fixture is the bleed source. In baseline (where session-memory.sh is wired into Stop), it emits the anti-pattern memory. In fix-v1-no-session, it emits nothing.

expected_anti_patterns_in_emitted_memory: top-level 'type' is missing/None — process-session-memory.py nests type inside metadata as 'Insight', leaving the top-level field absent (audit finding #5: queue records do not carry the public type enum at the level POST /memory inspects). hook_metrics.type_validity flags this as invalid_count.
